verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Notion's own dashboard, chart, or widget capability for reporting on project progress. The closest items are integrations that display Tableau or Mixpanel dashboards inside Notion; those are reports built in external tools, which is a user-side workaround rather than a native capability. Community mentions of tracking tasks and projects describe tracking, not reporting dashboards.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
